claims.quote: Tbc1d24 forms cytoophidia in neuronal cells both in vitro and in vivo.

claims.object_text: distinct from Impdh- and Ctps-based cytoophidia
claims.quote: The Tbc1d24 cytoophidia are distinct from previously reported cytoophidia consisting of inosine monophosphate dehydrogenase (Impdh) or cytidine-5'-triphosphate synthase (Ctps).

claims.object_text: cytoophidia induction by loss of cellular juvenescence (Gm14230 depletion and zeocin)
claims.quote: Tbc1d24 cytoophidia is induced by loss of cellular juvenescence caused by depletion of Gm14230, a juvenility-associated lncRNA (JALNC) and zeocin treatment.

claims.object_text: impaired enzymatic activity associated with cytoophidia formation
claims.quote: Cytoophidia formation is associated with impaired enzymatic activity of Tbc1d24.
